RCA before repair (rebar-debug Phase 1):

Step 0(a): searched for `gate_status REVIEW_RESULT sidecar stale findings terminal`, `gate_status`, and `REVIEW_RESULT gate_status`; current ticket is the active report. Prior related closed bug `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231` introduced the async gate handle/poll surface, but did not cover REVIEW_RESULT readability.
Step 0(b): ticket has no quoted version; created_at 1788332684139080595 maps to floor commit a85cb4781845ccf0d8c0375adce9a01391ba4bc8. No later changes to the suspect paths before current HEAD 384ca0dc2d7c.
Step 0(c): fresh worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/debug-gate-status-sidecar` is at 384ca0dc2d7c (= origin/main).

Design-decision check: docs/plan-review-gate.md and AGENTS.md document `review_plan_start` -> poll `gate_status(job_id)` as the long-gate workflow, with terminal `passed/failed` carrying durable attestation currency. `plan_review_verdict.schema.json` documents `sidecar_emitted`, and the ticket explicitly allows either deferring terminal visibility or adding a readability indicator. No ADR/ticket found that intentionally permits terminal-with-stale-findings; this is a defect fix honoring the documented poll contract, not a contract change.

Proven mechanism: `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:141-178` builds a terminal poll response solely from the `.rebar/gate_runs/<job_id>` index record plus signed-attestation currency. It never checks whether the plan-review `REVIEW_RESULT` sidecar for that run exists/readable. `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:148-179` records `status=passed`/`verdict=<BLOCK|PASS>` in the run index from the returned result, and `_terminal_from_result` treats a BLOCK verdict as `passed` (completed). For BLOCK there is no signed plan-review attestation, so the existing `durable` block is `unsigned` by design and cannot distinguish “findings not readable yet” from “BLOCK has no attestation.”

Runtime proof: in a local scratch repo, I wrote an older `REVIEW_RESULT`, then recorded a terminal plan_review gate-run index for a newer job without writing a new sidecar. `gate_runs.gate_run_status(job_id)` returned `{'status':'passed','verdict':'BLOCK',...}` while `sidecar.latest_review_result(ticket)` returned the old finding (`old-finding`). This exactly reproduces the silent stale-read window.

Defect origin: introduced by commit 44ec1c2e67373a2e2b888a1beb0bf1cb7b0f6d39 (`d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231: async gate start (P2)`), which added `gate_run_status` and documented terminal `passed/failed` without a per-run sidecar-readability token. Blame/log -L on `gate_run_status` points to that new-file commit. I attempted to record an early `caused_by` link to `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231`, but the tracker refused it because it could not find a referencing commit for the target; I will still pass `--caused-by=d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231` on bug close.

Caller-dependency gate: expected post-fix behavior is additive: plan-review `gate_status` includes whether this job’s REVIEW_RESULT findings are readable. `rg` found only MCP read registration, docs, and tests; no production caller relies on the absence of a findings-readability field. Existing status/verdict semantics remain unchanged.

comments.author: Rebar Bot
comments.body:
Checkpoint/final status for bug 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530 (`beige-acute-bobolink`):

RCA is proven. The race was not an in-process terminal-before-emit ordering bug; `review_plan()` already emitted before the async daemon wrote the terminal gate-run record. The actual defect was missing per-run `REVIEW_RESULT` identity/readability: `sidecar.emit()` only returned a bool, the async gate-run index discarded sidecar outcome/receipt, `gate_status()` reported terminal verdict/durable attestation without proving findings readability, and `latest_review_result(ticket)` was newest-by-ticket rather than job-scoped. For BLOCK verdicts, unsigned attestation cannot prove findings readiness, so callers could silently read stale prior-run findings.

Fix landed in Gerrit change 2521. It records/carries an exact sidecar receipt (`sidecar_reviewed_at`) from `append_event()` through sidecar emit/reuse and the async gate-run index, and exposes `gate_status(job_id).findings` with `readable`, `reason`, `reviewed_at`, and diagnostic `latest_reviewed_at`. Pollers can now wait for `findings.readable=true` for the current run before reading findings; stale newest-by-ticket sidecars are not treated as current.

Current state: Gerrit change 2521 merged as `8a38aa7656d5405813a72ff3d61d4fb6f1759cfd` with `LLM-Review+1`, `Verified+1`, and zero unresolved comments. Ticket is closed as `regression`, caused by `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231`, with certified `completion-verifier` opcert. No design-decision escalation was hit.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`review_plan_start(ticket)` returns a `job_id`; callers poll `gate_status(job_id)` and then read retained `REVIEW_RESULT` findings. The bug is that a terminal plan-review poll (`status:"passed"`, `verdict:"BLOCK"`) did not prove that the readable `REVIEW_RESULT` belonged to that same run. A caller reading "latest findings" could silently consume a prior run's findings.

Observed 2026-09-01 on ticket `549b-9cc5-940e-46c3`: job `1788326596882647223-94573cf0d90d404e87c74855306c16f2` reported terminal BLOCK while the newest readable sidecar was prior-run file `1788325963941841589-...-REVIEW_RESULT.json`; the current sidecar `1788327281362056852-...-REVIEW_RESULT.json` appeared later.

## Root cause / actual layer

`review_plan()` already calls `sidecar.emit()` before `_spawn_gate_daemon()` records the terminal `.rebar/gate_runs/<job_id>` entry. The defect is not a simple in-process order inversion; it is missing per-run sidecar identity:

- `sidecar.emit()` was best-effort and returned only a bool.
- `_spawn_gate_daemon()` discarded sidecar outcome/identity when writing the terminal run index.
- `gate_run_status()` reported terminal status plus attestation currency only. For BLOCK, the attestation is unsigned by definition, so `durable` cannot prove findings readiness.
- `sidecar.latest_review_result(ticket)` is newest-by-ticket, not job-scoped.

Thus a terminal run without an exact sidecar receipt cannot distinguish current findings from stale latest findings, an unreadable tracker view, a legacy index, or permanent sidecar failure.

## Fix plan

Add an exact receipt while preserving existing contracts.

1. `_commands._seam.append_event()` returns the event-envelope timestamp as an additive receipt; existing callers may ignore it.
2. `plan_review.sidecar.emit()` still returns bool, and also stamps `verdict["sidecar_reviewed_at"]` with the timestamp returned by `append_event()`.
3. `plan_review.__init__` keeps `verdict["sidecar_emitted"]` boolean semantics unchanged while carrying that stamped receipt on the verdict.
4. Reuse short-circuits that return current stored findings (`reuse.idempotent_reuse` and `reuse.verdict_reuse`) set `sidecar_reviewed_at` from the reused sidecar's filename timestamp while keeping `sidecar_emitted=false` because they did not write a new sidecar. Drift refresh/cancellation remain no-new-findings paths.
5. `_mcp_llm._spawn_gate_daemon()` copies `sidecar_emitted` and any exact `sidecar_reviewed_at` from the completed review result into the terminal run index.
6. `gate_status(job_id)` adds `findings` for plan-review jobs: `sidecar_type`, `readable`, `reason`, `reviewed_at`, `latest_reviewed_at`, and legacy diagnostic `job_started_at`.
7. `findings.readable=true` only when a file with the exact `sidecar_reviewed_at` prefix exists and parses as a supported `plan_review_result_v1/v2` payload. It never infers freshness from newest timestamp or job start time.

Disposition: no `findings` block is attached when the job is `unknown` because there is no indexed ticket/gate type. For indexed plan-review jobs, `findings.sidecar_type` is always `REVIEW_RESULT`. `current-review-result-sidecar` is readable. `sidecar-not-emitted` is a new record with `sidecar_emitted=false` and no receipt; `review-result-generation-unknown` is a legacy terminal record with no receipt fields; `run-failed` is a terminal gate failure with no review result; `run-stale-running` is a crashed-leader unavailable state. `review-result-sidecar-missing` covers absent, unreadable, corrupt, or unsupported exact-prefix files; callers may keep polling only under their normal bounded wait policy and must not read latest findings while false. `run-running` and `run-attaching` mean keep polling.

## Scope / file impact

- `src/rebar/_commands/_seam.py`: additive timestamp return from `append_event()`.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py`: stamp `sidecar_reviewed_at` while preserving bool return; reuse reads exact payload timestamps from existing `all_review_results()`.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py`: verified call site; bool `sidecar_emitted` remains unchanged.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/reuse.py`: carry reused current sidecar receipts on no-new-sidecar paths.
- `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py`: store the exact completed-review receipt in the terminal async run index.
- `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py`: compute the plan-review `findings` readability block.
- `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verdict.schema.json`: document/model additive fields.
- `tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_async.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_sidecar_reader.py`: regression and receipt tests.
- `AGENTS.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/mcp-reference.md`: document waiting for `findings.readable` before reading findings.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Seed an old `REVIEW_RESULT`, record a terminal newer run with expected `sidecar_reviewed_at`, omit that sidecar, and assert `gate_status` is terminal with `findings.readable=false`, `reason="review-result-sidecar-missing"`.
- [x] Write the expected current sidecar and assert the same job reports `findings.readable=true` with `reason="current-review-result-sidecar"`.
- [x] Drive two successive runs and assert poll-then-read returns no findings for the newer job until that job's exact sidecar is readable.
- [x] Assert terminal `sidecar_emitted=false` without a receipt reports `findings.readable=false` and `reason="sidecar-not-emitted"`.
- [x] Assert terminal `sidecar_emitted=false` with a reused `sidecar_reviewed_at` reports `findings.readable=true` for that exact sidecar.
- [x] Assert exact-prefix corrupt or unsupported sidecar files report `findings.readable=false` with `reason="review-result-sidecar-missing"`.
- [x] Assert `findings.latest_reviewed_at` reflects the newest-by-ticket sidecar timestamp for diagnostics only and is not used to infer readability.
- [x] Assert an unknown job has no `findings` block.
- [x] Assert `findings.sidecar_type` is `REVIEW_RESULT`.
- [x] Assert the daemon records the exact receipt returned by `review_plan()` even when a newer same-ticket sidecar is already readable.
- [x] Assert legacy terminal records without a receipt report `findings.readable=false`, `reason="review-result-generation-unknown"`, with `job_started_at` diagnostic only.
- [x] Assert non-terminal plan-review runs report `findings.readable=false`, `reason="run-<status>"`, and `reviewed_at=null`.
- [x] Assert terminal failed plan-review runs without a review result report `findings.readable=false` and `reason="run-failed"`.
- [x] [non-codebase] Validate with targeted pytest, MCP schema coverage, `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test`.
  provenance: environment=debug-gate-status-sidecar worktree at merged Gerrit SHA 8a38aa7656d5405813a72ff3d61d4fb6f1759cfd plus GitHub Actions run 33683396633; principal=RebarBotNava/Copilot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Local pytest/lint/typecheck/schema/full-suite commands and Gerrit CI ran against the production code review path.

## Non-goals

- Changing verdict computation or whether a BLOCK is a completed (`passed`) gate run.
- Making `REVIEW_RESULT` sidecars required for the verdict; they remain best-effort observability.
- Changing `plan_review_status` or signed-attestation currency.
